policy.hypothesis_description: Immutable control baseline (A1 and D1) under repaired OOS and $2.50 risk policy.
Cancel entries where causal H1 or H4 structure bias opposes trade direction at decision time.
Require closed-bar M1 MSS/BOS break and causal displacement body >= 1.25x ATR(1M) without >4x ATR late extension.
Require causal Unicorn Breaker+FVG overlap with closed-candle retest confirmed <= decision_timestamp_ms.
Require SL to sit outside the outer causal protected structure with >= 1.5x ATR(1M) distance while keeping planned_net_risk_usd <= $2.50 and quantity >= 0.01 lot.
Require unswept causal M5/M15/H1 target with net_rr in [2.0, 3.5] to avoid unreachable distant HTF targets.
Require active causal ICT macro time window (London/NY macro windows) with DST-aware NY clock.
Pre-declared combination of R1 (causal H1/H4 non-conflict) + R2 (confirmed MSS & displacement) + R4 (outer protected structure SL within $2.50 risk cap) + R6 (active ICT macro window).
